title: Neural-network screening guides a tested soft-magnetic iron alloy
summary: An artificial neural network fitted literature magnetic-property measurements and guided selection of Fe83B9P3C4Nb1 for synthesis. The annealed ribbon showed saturation magnetic flux density of 1.71 tesla and coercivity of 0.5 amperes per metre. These are laboratory measurements of one selected composition, without established broad predictive accuracy or device benefit.

evidence.tested: One model-selected alloy was synthesized, structurally characterized and magnetically measured in as-spun and annealed states.
evidence.unknown: The March 2022 preprint already reports this composition and experimental verification; quoted measurements come from the later journal version. Predicted coercivity differed substantially.
evidence.ai_role: An ANN learned composition-property relationships; predicted magnetic-property filters narrowed a combinatorial composition search before experimental selection.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary journal Methods/results and exact SSRN posted-date/abstract evidence; current publisher and Crossref metadata checked.
